usage.source_scope: 面向任务的细粒度功能部件与 affordance 标注。
usage.project_application: 作为 L10 功能落点候选：先绑定正确实例，再在实例内部定位门把手、按钮、座位接触面等真正执行功能的区域。
usage.modifications: 保持现有 exact-instance authority 与候选分母；只新增 functional-element 表示，不允许用父对象 bbox 直接充当动作目标。
usage.expected_effect: 在实例身份正确但功能部件错误的故障上，提高 functional-element 命中率并降低 parent-box false handoff。

evaluation.setup: One SceneFun3D v1 train scene (visit 420683, video 42445137); ARKit OBB parent binding; GT functional masks used only as unlabeled proposals and evaluator truth; public task text drives the selector.
evaluation.effect: SC8 task-relational functional binding improved legal commits from 4/6 to 6/6, mean target-set recall from 0.50 to 1.00, and wrong parts from 2 to 0; parent centers were false handoff points in 6/6 evaluable tasks.
evaluation.claim_boundary: The positive result is limited to one SceneFun3D Development scene with evaluator-provided functional-part proposals and ARKit parent boxes. It does not establish RGB proposal generation, phone-camera transfer, open-world coverage, reachability, orientation, arrival, completion, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.
Executed the first SC8 SceneFun3D Development canary and adopted the dataset as the functional-part proposal/evaluator source; next work must add an RGB/RGB-D proposer behind the frozen interface.
Tightened the claim boundary after the SC8 result so the partial proposal-conditional reproduction is not described as unexecuted or promoted to downstream capability.
